title: Pausa, configuración y menú de usuario
description: Desktop regression: separate pause and user menus, settings hierarchy, keyboard focus, controller navigation, exit and return. The scene's last rendered frame stays behind the menus to keep software WebGL captures light; gameplay updates and input remain active. Never connects the real house lights.

steps.caption: Dos accesos independientes: Gerard · Tab y Pausa · Esc

steps.eval: const menu = document.querySelector('#controller-menu'); if (menu.dataset.page !== 'home' || menu.querySelectorAll('.pause-options button').length !== 2 || menu.querySelector('[data-panel]')) throw Error('Pause must contain only configuration and exit'); if (!document.activeElement.matches('[data-open=settings]')) throw Error('Pause focus'); window.menuPosition = JSON.stringify(window.gerard.game.position); window.menuStory = JSON.stringify(window.gerard.story.saved);
if (JSON.stringify(window.gerard.game.position) !== window.menuPosition) throw Error('Game moves while paused');

steps.eval: if (!document.querySelector('#exploration-panel').contains(document.activeElement)) throw Error('User menu loses keyboard focus');
if (JSON.stringify(window.gerard.game.position) !== window.menuPosition) throw Error('Game moves in user menu');

steps.caption: Objetos comunes y clave en el menú de usuario

steps.eval: if (document.querySelector('#hud').dataset.panel || document.querySelector('#controller-menu').open) throw Error('Escape must close user menu without opening pause'); document.querySelector('[data-user-menu]').click();

window.fakeMenuPad = { id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: 0, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', axes: [0,0,0,0], buttons: Array.from({length: 17}, () => ({pressed:false,value:0})) }; navigator.getGamepads = () => [window.fakeMenuPad];
if (!document.activeElement.matches('[data-exit]')) throw Error('Keyboard cannot select exit');
if (document.querySelector('#controller-menu').dataset.page !== 'exited') throw Error('Exit resumes without choosing to play');
